A real coach for every rep you record

Post your fitness goal and coaches pitch you their plan. You record your sets on your phone, Formtrace traces your form, and your coach reviews every session.

Free to join. You only pay for a goal when you accept a coach's offer.

Why Formtrace is different

  • Your form, traced

    Every set you record is checked against your coach's reference movement, rep by rep, so you see what to fix straight away.

  • A coach who actually watches

    Your coach reviews each session with voice notes and drawings on your video, plans your weeks and books calls with you.

  • Optimize results

    Weekly check-in photos, your weight, macros and progress charts show what is working, so your coach can adjust your plan every week.

  • Pay for progress, not promises

    Formtrace holds your payment and releases it to your coach one delivered week at a time. Weeks you don't use come back to you.

  • Better with friends

    Streaks, achievements and friends cheering you on keep you showing up week after week.

How it works

  1. Post your goal

    Say what you want to achieve, for how long, and how often you can train.

  2. Choose your coach

    Coaches send you their plan and price. Compare them and accept the one that fits you.

  3. Train, record, improve

    Do your workouts, record your sets and get your coach's review after every session.

Before you start

One-off confirmation
What Formtrace stores about you
To coach you, this app records: videos of you exercising, with sound, weekly progress photos, body measurements and weight, and what you eat.
Your coach can see this while you work together. Nobody else can — it isn't public, isn't sold, and isn't used for advertising. Two exceptions, both deliberate: videos you post to the marketplace are visible to coaches browsing for trainees, and your age is shown on your profile to anyone who views it.
Your date of birth itself is never shown or shared — only the age calculated from it.
You can delete your account at any time from Profile. That permanently removes your photos, videos, food logs and measurements, and strips your name from anything shared.
This is an early-access build. Don't record anything you wouldn't want a coach to see.
You must be 18 or over to use Formtrace, because it records progress photos.
